title: Comelec: Delisted party-list groups may reapply until Dec. 30, 2026

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Fifty delisted party-list groups seeking to join the 2028 elections must prove their track records and qualifications to regain accreditation with the Commission on Elections (Comelec), Comelec chair George Erwin Garcia said on Saturday. The groups may reapply by filing new petitions for accreditation before the Dec. 30 deadline. They will be treated as new applicants and must meet the requirements without any advantage from their previous registration, Garcia said. “Their petition is back to zero,” he said in a radio interview with DZMM.
